features.section_description: End-to-end procurement management designed for hospitality scale and complexity.

unified_catalog.title: Unified Procurement Catalog
unified_catalog.description: Access thousands of verified hospitality products through a single, centralized interface with real-time availability and competitive pricing intelligence.

supplier_intelligence.title: Supplier Intelligence Engine
supplier_intelligence.description: AI-powered vendor assessment and selection tools with real-time performance metrics, compliance verification, and automated procurement recommendations.

order_management.title: Order Orchestration
order_management.description: Streamline order placement, tracking, and fulfillment with automated workflows, ETA compliance monitoring, and exception management.

factoring.title: Working Capital Solutions
factoring.description: Accelerate cash flow with integrated invoice factoring and payment optimization tools designed specifically for hospitality procurement cycles.

inventory.title: Inventory Intelligence
inventory.description: Optimize stock levels with predictive analytics, automated reordering, and intelligent consumption forecasting for hospitality operations.

eta_compliance.title: ETA Compliance Framework
eta_compliance.description: Ensure regulatory adherence with automated documentation, audit trails, and compliance validation for all procurement activities.

how_it_works.section_description: Accelerate time-to-value with our structured implementation methodology.

step_1.title: Platform Initialization
step_1.description: Complete organizational setup with tenant provisioning, user role configuration, and system integration preparation.

step_2.title: Supplier Network Activation
step_2.description: Connect your existing vendors or discover new suppliers through our verified marketplace with automated onboarding workflows.

step_3.title: Operational Deployment
step_3.description: Launch procurement workflows with team training, process validation, and ongoing optimization support.

quote_1.text: The procurement automation has fundamentally transformed our operational efficiency. We've reduced vendor management overhead by 65% while improving compliance visibility.
quote_1.author: Amr Hassan

quote_2.author: Sherine Ezzat

quote_3.text: The supplier intelligence capabilities have given us unprecedented visibility into vendor performance. We've optimized our supply base and reduced procurement costs.
quote_3.author: Mohamed Khalil
